name: com.searchupside/wa-sales-tax
title: WA Sales Tax
description: Washington sales tax rates by address, live from the WA Department of Revenue. No sign-in.

tools.name: wa_tax_rate
tools.description: Combined sales tax rate, state/local split, DOR location code and quarter for a Washington address, with how exact the match was. ZIP-only matches are approximate: ZIP codes cross city and district lines. Give a date for another quarter's rate. Privacy: addresses are sent to the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR) to look up the rate. Search Upside doesn't store anything you send.

address.description: Full street address with ZIP, e.g. "416 Sid Snyder Ave SW, Olympia, WA 98504". Units like "Apt 4" are fine.

city.description: City, if not in the address.

zip.description: 5- or 9-digit ZIP, if not in the address.

date.description: Sale or job date (2026-08-14), month (2026-08) or quarter (Q32026). Picks that quarter's rate. Default: the current quarter.

tools.name: wa_tax_on
tools.description: Sales tax and total for an amount at a Washington address, at DOR's rate for that address and quarter. Takes the amount as taxable; it does not decide taxability. Privacy: addresses are sent to the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR) to look up the rate. Search Upside doesn't store anything you send.

amount.description: Taxable amount in dollars, e.g. 1250 or "1,250.00".

address.description: Full street address with ZIP, e.g. "416 Sid Snyder Ave SW, Olympia, WA 98504". Units like "Apt 4" are fine.

city.description: City, if not in the address.

zip.description: 5- or 9-digit ZIP, if not in the address.

date.description: Sale or job date (2026-08-14), month (2026-08) or quarter (Q32026). Picks that quarter's rate. Default: the current quarter.

tools.name: wa_return_by_location
tools.description: Looks up each job's DOR location code and totals the taxable amount and tax per code, the way the Washington combined excise return's local sales tax section asks for it. Give each job (or the whole call) a date so it gets its own quarter's rate; returns for a past quarter need this. Takes every amount as taxable as given; it does not decide taxability or deductions. Up to 100 jobs per call. Privacy: addresses are sent to the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR) to look up the rate. Search Upside doesn't store anything you send.

date.description: Date or quarter for every job without its own date, e.g. Q32026.
Sale or job date, month or quarter.
